source.note: Cross-checked against https://game8.co/games/Elden-Ring/archives/351883 (Game8 Controller Layout and Button Settings guide); both sources agree on all Xbox Series X/S default button mappings listed above.
source.method: read from the web by agent/research.py

confidence: researched, not checked by a person

right_stick.action: Reset camera / Lock-on target / Remove target (R3 click)

right_bumper.action: Attack with right-hand or two-handed armament

right_trigger.action: Strong attack with right-hand or two-handed armament

left_trigger.action: Use equipped weapon skill (Ash of War)

Y.action: Event action (examine, open, interact, pick up); also hold with LB/LT or RB/RT to toggle two-handing

disputed.Y: Also functions as a hold-modifier combined with left_bumper/left_trigger (switch left-hand weapon to two-handed) or right_bumper/right_trigger (switch right-hand weapon to two-handed); this two-handing combo cannot be represented as a single distinct control in the given naming scheme.
